approved_task_config.title: Brown representability for compactly generated triangulated categories

standard_prerequisites.name: Yoneda lemma and cohomological functors
standard_prerequisites.statement: An element of H(X) gives a natural map Hom(-,X)→H; exact triangles yield long exact sequences.

standard_prerequisites.name: Compact objects and countable mapping telescopes
standard_prerequisites.statement: A compact C has Hom(C,hocolim X_n)=colim Hom(C,X_n). A compact generating family detects zero objects through all shifts.

standard_prerequisites.name: Localizing closure of the isomorphism locus
standard_prerequisites.statement: The locus where a natural transformation of cohomological functors is an isomorphism on every shift is triangulated and closed under summands; if both preserve coproducts as products it is closed under coproducts.

core_obligations: Construct successive representing approximations by adjoining all generator values and killing kernels through cones; lift compatible functor elements to the homotopy colimit.

Prove bijectivity on compact generators using finite-stage factorization and kernel annihilation, then propagate it to the whole category through the supplied generator-cell approximation construction.
